short_description: The Way of Freedom is an ecstatic dance journey to release, expand and return to your truth. We begin with a warm-up, move into 20 minutes of breathwork, and then enter a free-flowing dance journey guided by music.
description:
**The Way of Freedom** is an immersive ecstatic dance journey designed to help you release what no longer belongs to you, expand your energy and reconnect with your inner truth.

We will begin with a gentle warm-up to arrive in the body, soften the mind and create a safe space for movement. From there, we will move into a 20-minute breathwork session to open the breath, activate presence and prepare the body for a deeper experience.

After the breathwork, the ecstatic dance journey begins: a DJ live set created as a musical wave, guiding you through different rhythms, emotions and states of expression. A space to move freely, let go of control, connect with your body and allow the music to lead you back to yourself.

Come as you are. No experience needed. Just your body, your breath and your willingness to move.

[More information](https://esmerise.com/alwarecstatic/pages/thewayoffreedom)
title: The Way of Freedom
